seo.title: 530 Spray Foam — Insulation in Redding & the North Valley
seo.description: Closed-cell and open-cell spray foam insulation across Shasta, Tehama, Butte and Glenn. Free walkthrough, fixed-price quote, 10-year workmanship warranty.

hero.lede: A 2,000 sq ft home in Redding loses roughly a third of its conditioned air through the attic. Foam stops it in a day — and we file the utility rebate for you.

foam.heading: Open cell or closed cell?
foam.sub: Both are foam. Which one you want comes down to where it's going and what it has to stop.

cards.name: Open cell
cards.body: Softer, breathable, best value for attics and interior walls. Great sound damping between bedrooms and shops.

cards.name: Closed cell
cards.body: Rigid, vapor-tight, adds structural rigidity. The pick for crawlspaces, metal buildings and exterior assemblies.

foam.specNote: Full submittal packet, ICC-ES reports and Title 24 docs available on request.

about.heading: Northern California, one building at a time
about.body: 530 Spray Foam is committed to serving Northern California with quality spray foam insulation and roof coatings. We're local, licensed and insured, and we treat every job like it's going on our own house — masked off, sprayed right, cleaned up before we go.
points: Spray foam insulation — attics, crawlspaces, walls, shops and barns
Roof coatings that seal and reflect, on metal and flat roofs
Free walkthrough and a fixed price before we start

financing.heading: Financing & rebates
financing.body: 0% for 18 months on approved credit, and we file your utility rebate paperwork for you.
points: 0% APR for 18 months, or fixed terms out to 84 months on approved credit.
We prepare and submit the utility rebate paperwork — you sign, we file.
Federal 25C energy-efficiency credit paperwork included with your invoice.
Quotes are fixed-price. No change orders unless you change the scope.
